Explanation: How bright and strange will the tails of Comet Tsuchinshan-ATLAS become? C/2023 A3 (Tsuchinshan-ATLAS) became of the brightest comets of the past century over the past few days, but was unfortunately hard to see because it was so nearly superposed on the Sun. The featured animated video shows how the comet's tails have developed, as viewed from Earth, and gives one prediction about how they might further develop.
